name: aged_newtonian_cement_delivery

material.density_basis: Nominal design densities for volume conversion and gravity; the rheology paper does not report cement density.
material.interpolation: Shape-preserving cubic Hermite interpolation in age at each measured concentration, followed by the same interpolation in local solid volume fraction. Add the pure-water node at every age.
material.dilute_extension: Between water and the lowest measured concentration (w/c=10), the water-anchored interpolation is the specified constitutive extension.

feed.preparation: Cement for both feeds is wetted at the common zero of the injection clock. Reservoirs are kept mixed. All transported cement has the same hydration age; the local concentration accounts for dilution and retention.
feed.stock_sizing: Prepare the plan-specific drawn stock volumes plus the specified unused reserve before injection. The reserve remains in its mixed reservoir at stop and is charged to freshly prepared material; no recovery credit is applied.
feed.equipment: The constructed supply control plane is at the column face, with zero line hold-up and zero stock reserve. Feed is blended by volumetric fractions from the two mixed stocks and pure water. Equipment outside this defined control volume is not modeled.

column.basis: Constructed, initially saturated upward column with six 0.05 m segments. Pressure is imposed across the column faces. Geometry, permeability and pressure are design inputs.

reference: All schedules share q0=k0*Delta_p/(mu_ref*L), where mu_ref is the measured initial viscosity of the first feed. Time is L/q0; t=1 is the end of the saved observation interval.
